node: Sulphur and sulphuric acid feedstock for copper, nickel HPAL, and fertilizers
summary: Expanded the node universe toward underfollowed US-tradable exposure rather than obvious copper, nickel, or fertilizer headlines. The strongest underfollowed mappings are Chemtrade Logistics as a North American sulphuric-acid and sulphur chemicals supplier, and Itafos as a small-cap phosphate producer whose Conda facility has explicit dependence on Rio Tinto Kennecott sulphuric acid. Mosaic is a liquid US-listed fertilizer reference/customer with sulfur-to-acid exposure but the benefit direction is mixed because sulfur/acid shortages can raise input costs. Ardmore Shipping is a speculative logistics-adjacent candidate: it is US-listed and operates product/chemical tankers, but specific sulphuric-acid-route exposure must be verified before it graduates.
